9
Students are asked for examples of water being used to store energy.
Three examples are listed.
1
energy stored in water waves
2
energy stored in tides
3
energy stored in water behind dams
Which examples describe water being used to store energy?
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics
